So... What is this splendid plan of yours?
那么……你口中那个绝妙的计划到底是什么？
dataList.place:
Cabins of Mephistopheles
梅菲斯托费勒斯 船舱

dataList.content:
I don't think there were words in this world expressive enough to describe that look on Heathcliff's face.
希斯克利夫脸上的表情复杂到难以用语言形容。

It was certain that he had very scant expectations for Don Quixote and her plans. But... there was this sliver of hope in his face that, maybe, just maybe... Don Quixote might rise to the occasion for once.
虽然很明显他并没对堂吉诃德的计划抱有什么期待，但他的表情似乎又流露出一些，也许，说不定……这样的内心想法。

Mmh hm hm...!
嗯哼哼……

It was unclear whether Heathcliff's internal struggle mattered much to Don Quixote, however. She began excitedly describing her plan.
不知道堂吉诃德是否察觉到了希斯克利夫这纠结的心情。她开始充满期待地、兴奋地讲述她的计划。

Didst thou, Sir Heathcliff, ever hear tale of the ancient and legendary Fixer of Devyat' Association... The Red Sack?
希斯克利夫先生，汝可曾听过那位来自Девять协会……那位很久以前的传奇收尾人，冬红布袋的故事吗？

The Red— what? Like Vergilius?
冬红……什么，像维吉里乌斯一样吗？

It is said that the legendary Red Sack carried out his deliveries no matter how terrible the terrain or how arduous the journey to all corners of the City! And with him was his sidekick, Reindeer-Man!
冬红布袋……与他的助手驯鹿人一同，穿梭于都市每处！无论是多么严酷的环境，他们都必定能完成派送任务。

Forsooth! His magnificence hath given away gratuitous gifts for children of the City that he deemed to be 'kind'.
特别！是在圣诞节时，据说他会无偿给都市里的好孩子们分发礼物。

'Tis but common knowledge, Sir Heathcliff. He appeareth on the front cover of the Fixers Monthly every winter!
嗯，他明明每年冬天都会出现在收尾人杂志的封面上。汝为何会不认识他呢？

Don Quixote asked, sounding genuinely shocked to learn that Heathcliff did not know of this 'Red Sack'.
堂吉诃德用难以置信的语气说道。

What makes you think I'd ever read rags like that...?
你觉得我会读那种玩意吗……？

Fie to thee! 'Rags' thou sayeth? Manager Esquire! Surely thou hast heard of this magnificent publication?
啊哈，此言过甚！经理老爷！汝一定听说过吧？

I knocked on my ticking clock head. I didn't really feel the need to spell it out for her.
我觉得少说几句话可能更好，于是只是用手轻轻敲了敲滴答作响的钟表头。

So none of thee has subscribed to it, then... Mine words fell on deaf ears...
结果……无人订阅吗……亏吾还如此努力地向汝等高声推荐……

A-anyhow! What matters to thee, Sir Heathcliff, is that thou endeavoureth to make thyself more presentable than anyone else for this occasion, is it not?!
无论如何！重要的是吾等的希斯克利夫必须打扮得既出色又时髦，不输给任何人，不是吗！

Finally getting to the point, eh? Go on.
终于回到正题上了。继续说吧。

Marry, good Sir, a costume most befitting that occasion would be those of the Red Sack and his sidekick, Reindeer-Man!!!
吾深知！作为打扮参考的最佳典范，正是冬红布袋和他的助手驯鹿人的装束！

Haah... This isn't going to end well, is it?
哈……有种不好的预感啊。

What, like those ridiculous Fixers del Atardecer Ardi-whatever?
难道是那种像燃烧夕阳的什么什么一样的奇怪衣服吗？

'Tis not ridiculous! Fie, thou hast not even deigned to indulge mine only wish that we would cosplay Fixers del Atardecer Ardiente together! Thou hast not even given it a chance, indeed! Speak not on a matter thou knowest naught about!
完全不奇怪！而且汝都未曾亲自cosplay过“夕阳的收尾人”，怎能如此评判！连衣服都未曾亲自试穿，就别说这种话语！！

With all that talk of a 'splendid plan', I thought you were actually going somewhere... But it all comes around to that Fixer nonsense again, eh?
还在想你这么嚣张要干什么……原来又来收尾人那一套废话。

Haah... Don't even have the energy to beat the sense into you. I'll get to it later. Five honest hits to the noggin should do it...
哈啊……现在没什么力气，总之之后再给你来五下……

When the sliver of hope on Heathcliff's face was beginning to rapidly fade...
正当信赖两个字逐渐从希斯克利夫的表情中消失之时。

... Prithee, share thy thoughts of the Fixers that we have laid our eyes upon thus far.
……那汝想想迄今所见的收尾人究竟如何吧。

What?
啊？

Embarrassing, were they? Remember! Were they not fancy and impeccably dressed? Close not thy eyes and heart. Speak!
那些收尾人们看上去可笑吗？回忆一下吧。正相反，其身上的装扮难道不是又帅又整齐吗？瞪大眼睛、敞开心扉，坚定地回答吧！

Absolutely embarrassing sods, yeah. That spandex bloke from K Corp.? Looked like he leaped right out of a circus.
是啊。在K公司见到的那个紧身衣混蛋，光是想想就觉得好笑啊？

NAAAYYY! Lord Siegfried was not embarrassing! I say that his outfit was rather dashing, wouldst thou not agree?! Allow me to regale thee with information concerning the materials of its fabric, so that thy understanding—
并非如此！！！齐格飞大人才不好笑！那身装束十分帅气！！！！说起那个材质……

... Ahm. Excuse me. Huh?! Hie thee hither, Sir Heathcliff! I am yet unfinished!
咳哼，不好意思。诶！快些回来，希斯克利夫先生！吾还没说完呢！

Haah... Why's the girl so hyper today...?
啊……为什么她今天这么有精神呢……

W-well. Lord Siegfried is... a special outlier, mayhaps. But dost thou not agree that most Fixers are all rather well-dressed and wore honour upon their sleeves?
当然，也会有像齐格飞先生这样特立独行的人物，但是大部分收尾人都打扮得很得体、帅气……并且高贵，不是吗？

Honour upon their what? I don't know about that, but I suppose they were quite posh...
高贵……？不太清楚那是什么……好像是有穿着那样衣服的人……

Verily! Follow thee I, and thou shalt see thyself dressed as impeccably and impressively as the Fixers are!
正是如此！只要好好跟着吾，就可以原封不动地再现他们帅气的服装！

I-is that right? Sod it, I know shite-all about clothes or making myself look fancy...
是、是吗？妈的，即使想反驳，我对穿衣打扮也一窍不通啊……

Right, so let's say I go along with your plan. Where are we going to get them clothes? Honestly, everyone was right. Where are we even going to pick up clothes in the middle of a Lake?
所以呢？那样的衣服在哪里能买到呢。说实话，就像刚才其他人说的那样，在我们回到陆地上之前，基本上什么东西都弄不到啊。

Aha! Yet I have thought of that as well!
吾早就连那些问题也一并想好了！

Recall the events of yesterday. The sirens that echoed across this bus. Dost thou remember?
还记得昨天……这巴士上的警报响了吗？

Now that I think about it, there was a siren yesterday. It went off not long before I announced the close of business for the day.
这么说起来，昨天距离工作结束前没剩多久的时候，警报响过来着。

<But Faust said that that Backdoor volatility wasn't anything for us to worry about.>
<浮士德说那是不需要在意的后门波动。>

Yet I was curious. How, indeed, doth Faust determine which volatility is useful and which is not?! Thus, as all were crowded by the Backdoor, preoccupied with returning to their respective quarters...
吾很好奇。浮士德小姐到底是看到了什么，才能清晰地做出这种判断的！所以，当大家都拥挤在后门门口，一片混乱的时候……

I have, secretly and stealthily, availed myself the chance to take a glance at the screen!
吾独自一人谨慎而隐秘地前行，并且成功窥视到了那个屏幕！

<So you took a peep at the screen.>
<所以，你去偷偷扫了眼屏幕。>

You know how to read those complex symbols?
你能理解那些复杂的符号吗？

Nay, I myself had little hope of recognizing them. Yet, when I looked into them...
吾去看的时候没有怀抱着能够理解它们的希望……

... amongst the symbols on that device were a pair of rather particular symbols I could very easily tell apart from the others!
然而，那里的符号，出乎意料地容易推测！

Forsooth, 'twere symbols of the Red Sack and the Reindeer-Man! And next to them was a symbol indicating posh outfits!
而那正是，冬红布袋和驯鹿人的象征符号！还有象征着时髦衣服的符号！

... No. It can't be that simple.
不会那么简单……

Yeah, no. It can't be that simple.
没错，不可能那么简单的。

I agreed with Heathcliff. However, Don Quixote remained enthusiastic as ever, as though she was already expecting him to say that.
我也有同样的想法……但堂吉诃德似乎早已预料到了这样的回应，仍然保持着充满自信的样子。

Dost thou know?
汝知道吗？

Every so often, certain symbols appear on the numerous doors past the Backdoor.
后门里无数的门上……经常有符号浮现。

Every respite, every passing glance... I made sure to watch them carefully!
每当去休息的时候，每当路过它的时候……每当想起来的时候，吾都会仔细观察它……

And 'twas yesterday! When! In the corridor! I spied myself the exact door with the exact same symbol that I witnessed on the screen!
终于，就在昨天！吾在走廊里发现了有着和屏幕上完全一样的符号的门！

<... Don Quixote, you didn't...!>
<……堂吉诃德，难道说你！>

'Tis my nature as an adventurer, Manager Esquire! Mine inability to quell the burning adventurous spirit. I prostrate before thee!
非常抱歉，经理老爷！如果吾有什么过错的话，那就是错在没能抑制住吾内心沸腾的冒险天性。

Know that I have taken the sneakiest of peeks. Marry, twas naught too foolhardy! I have only taken a small peek!
但是当吾非常、非常短暂地……真的只是轻轻地打开那扇门观察内部的时候！

And if I were to regale thee that what I witnessed from within, that all my deductions and predictions have been proven true...
如果汝发现吾的所有推理和猜测都没错的话！

... could thee find within thyself compassion to spare mine soul?
……能不能稍微酌情宽大处理一下。

You absolute muppet, why in the bloody hell do you keep doing what everyone tells you not to?
这家伙为什么总是做别人提醒过不要做的事？

<Right, Heathcliff. I just don't understand why some people keep doing things that everyone tells them not to.>
<对啊，希斯克利夫。为什么会有人做这种事呢？>

... Ahem.
……咳哼。

I remember when Heathcliff ignored all warnings and went into the restricted areas past the area of the corridor that we're allowed to use.
我想起了希斯克利夫一意孤行地从后门的走廊进入禁区时的事。

... We almost lost Heathcliff that day.
那时如果搞不好……我们可能会失去希斯克利夫。

It was a tad different this time, however. Back then, Heathcliff had no idea what was beyond that door.
如果要说有什么不同的话，就是那时候的希斯克利夫连门那边有什么都不知道就开始了行动。

And this time, we do.
而现在我们已经知道了那边有着什么。

<Are you... suggesting that we call everyone over to explore that place?>
<所以……我们现在召集所有人，一起去那边探索吗？>

Nay! The three of us will be more than sufficient to handle this task. All tales begin with a party of three, indeed.
不！吾等三个不就够了吗。三个人就正好。所有的故事总是从三个人开始的。

<... You're just scared of the 'consultation', aren't you?>
<……不是因为面谈很恐怖吗？>

I-I have nary a clue as to what thou mayest be referring to~!
不、不知道汝在说什么~

The answer to this predicament was right there. Tell them that it's too dangerous and shove them back into their respective rooms to rest up for tomorrow.
简单想想，最好的做法是指出这么做风险太大，然后把他们两个送回各自的房间。

Manager Esquire... that zone... indeed, it appeared to be a place most peaceful to mine eyes...!
经理老爷……那里面看起来真的很和平……！

'Tis a simple task, is it not? All that we seek to do is to enter there and avail ourselves a few sets of clothes for Heathcliff...
吾等只需要，把希斯克利夫先生要穿的几件衣服拿出来就够了……

It was obvious that Don Quixote wasn't helping Heathcliff out of the pure kindness of her heart.
我知道堂吉诃德不是只因纯粹的善意才帮助希斯克利夫的。

Maybe she hungered for an adventure. Or maybe she thought she might be able to do that 'cosplay' of the Fixers she so admired.
是渴望冒险吗……或是想cosplay自己憧憬的收尾人吗。

But if we can find Heathcliff some nice clothes to put his heart at ease, then...
但是，如果能在那里弄到一些能让希斯克利夫放心的衣服的话……

... maybe I can do something about this before things get out of control. Like it did last time when I just let a Sinner's anxiety stew and exacerbate...
……或许能够预防之前那样因不安蔓延而导致的令人眩晕的结果。

<... Fine. But we're turning around at the first sign of danger.>
<……如果看起来危险，我们就要马上返回。>

Seriously...?
你认真的吗……

<Come on. You were willing to do it if it meant that you could pick up some clothes.>
<其实你也觉得，如果能弄到衣服的话就值得一试对吧。>

... Well, I suppose we'll be okay as long as Clockhead's with us.
……嘛，钟表头也一起的话应该没问题吧。

Heh heh... Well said. Then, let us reconvene tonight before Manager Esquire's quarters. We shall knock in the following rhythm: Knock, knock-knock, knock. Then, thou shalt whisper a secret code, to which then I—
哼哼……说得好。那么，今晚。在经理老爷的房间前。吾等用咚、咚咚、咚的敲门声和经理老爷对暗号……

Just go get some sleep.
回去了。

... I really hope this won't be a waste of time.
……希望这不会是浪费时间。

We agreed on a precise time before returning to our respective rooms.
我们约定了在走廊见面的时间后，回到了各自的房间。
